picks.title: OpenAI acquires presentation startup NextSlide
picks.why_it_matters: Signals OpenAI's expansion into productivity tools through acqui-hires, creating potential opportunities for AI-native workflow startups while validating the presentation/document automation space.

picks.title: Fastmail offers EU data region
picks.why_it_matters: Growing demand for EU data sovereignty creates tailwinds for startups building region-specific infrastructure, compliance tooling, or privacy-first alternatives to US-based SaaS.

picks.title: Suspected AI use is the entertainment industry's scarlet letter
picks.why_it_matters: The emerging backlash against AI in creative work signals market opportunity for startups building provenance tracking, content authentication, and human-verification tools.
